title: SCE formal proofs manifest (wire schema v1)
description: What a repository declares of its Verus proofs, judged by `sce-codegen formal proofs --manifest <file>` (docs/adr/0144, D1; docs/adr/0115, D10 and D13). Written by the repository; never emitted by SCE. Paths are read from the root of the Git work tree that holds this file, and every Rust file of that tree carrying a contract (`cfg_attr(verus_only`) is declared. Each proof is verified whole with the number of functions it records and nothing taken on trust, and each mutant, a change of the code that breaks what a user relies on, must be refused. No tool is named here: the judge pins its tools (docs/adr/0144, D3). Authoritative reader is sce-build/src/formal/proofs.rs, which refuses a key it does not know as `formal/declaration`. The stability status of this surface lives in this header alone; see SCE_WIRE_CONTRACTS.md.

file.description: The proved file, from the work tree's root.

compiled_by.description: The module that declares it, so the proof is of what runs.

breaks.description: What a user relies on that the change breaks.

from.description: Text found exactly once in the file.
